parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the gateway list.

- Start value: 1.
- Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

- Maximum value: 50.
- Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the resource resides.

parameters.name: StorageBundleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the gateway cluster.

> - If you do not specify ResourceRegionId, you must specify this parameter.
